title: Class Appearance Library + Hero Final

title: Room Academic Signal Precision
changes: Jadwal and Absensi signals now count only currently open attendance sessions still UNMARKED for the current participant; future sessions are excluded and completed attendance clears the count.
Room hero graduation visual enlarged and divider enabled on desktop and mobile.
Ringkasan fold cards remain collapsed by default but can now be opened on desktop.
Belum dibuka states in Jadwal and Absensi are represented by a compact clock icon instead of a long text pill.

title: Room + Classes + Bottom Nav Precision
summary: Restore class collapse/header surface, default-collapsed Room overview, horizontal submenus, larger room hero icon, and stable equal-slot mobile bottom navigation.

title: Mobile Room Member + Submenu + Bottom Nav Polish
changes: Larger submenu icons and one-line submenu header on mobile.
Member cards use two-line identity with a separate badge/action footer on mobile.
Bottom navigation uses five equal icon stations with a compact active highlight and no CTA block.

title: Room submenu click popover
summary: Submenu Akademik/Kelola hanya muncul saat tombol utama diklik dan dirender di luar container navigasi.

title: Room Class Recovery + Update Delivery Fix
changes: Memperbaiki mismatch frontend config 6.7.18 vs app-version/service-worker 6.7.19 yang membuat update berulang/nyangkut.
Memulihkan source Room Class dan CSS ke baseline v6.7.18 yang lengkap sebelum patch visual baru diterapkan.

Tombol tambah di modul Akademik menjadi ikon + yang compact dengan ID/action lama tetap dipertahankan.

title: Class Room Hero, Nav, and Schedule Precision Patch
changes: Refined Class Room hero for desktop and mobile, with larger square room visual and cleaner typography.
Compressed main room navigation and added mobile left/right scrollers for overflow.
Converted Academic/Manage submenus to a dropdown list on mobile while preserving chip navigation on desktop.
Moved Class Code and Join Code to the Ringkasan status block and kept room links in a dedicated panel.
Unified academic add actions into compact [+] buttons and tightened the schedule header and KPI strip.
